scenes.text: Quadrilateral clue card 1: which quadrilateral best matches four right angles and two longer sides plus two shorter sides? Let us think carefully. Rectangle matches these attributes. Some categories can overlap; use the intended most specific name. The answer is rectangle. Great work!

Quadrilateral clue card 2: which quadrilateral best matches four equal sides and four right angles? Let us think carefully. Square matches these attributes. Some categories can overlap; use the intended most specific name. The answer is square. Great work!

Quadrilateral clue card 3: which quadrilateral best matches four equal sides and no right angles? Let us think carefully. Rhombus matches these attributes. Some categories can overlap; use the intended most specific name. The answer is rhombus. Great work!

Quadrilateral clue card 4: which quadrilateral best matches two pairs of parallel sides, no right angles and adjacent sides of different lengths? Let us think carefully. Parallelogram matches these attributes. Some categories can overlap; use the intended most specific name. The answer is parallelogram. Great work!
